name: JobsPipe
description: Universal Jobs API agent. Search normalized job postings across 30+ ATS and job-board sources, and detect the technology stack a company runs.

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: JobsPipe API key as a Bearer token, prefixed jp_live_. Issued at https://jobspipe.dev/signup — there is no anonymous or OAuth credential issuance.

skills.name: Search job postings
skills.description: Query normalized job postings with filters for sort order, pagination, budget, and client attributes.
examples: Find the 50 most recent job postings
List postings sorted by budget descending

skills.name: Scan company tech stack
skills.description: Detect the technologies a company runs by scanning its website domain.
examples: Scan stripe.com for its technology stack
